title: PAR-144 generated non-default current Paper layout fast slice

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was broadly dirty before this slice. This change touched the existing generated DWG roundtrip test and the plan; no existing edits were reverted or broadly staged.

slice.scope: Generated AC1024 serialization/readback of a non-default current Paper layout association.
slice.implementation: The canonical *Paper_Space BLOCK_RECORD is associated with LOCAL_LAYOUT_DPI; Layout1 is associated with a distinct *Paper_Space7 record. The canonical active Paper owner carries generated LINE/TEXT/two-VIEWPORT sentinels, while the second inactive Paper layout remains a separate block owner. The test checks reciprocal layout/block-record links, viewport references, parsed entity space, exact handles, and writer-ledger membership.
slice.evidenceBoundary: This proves the local serialized selection relation and same-library structural roundtrip only. It does not prove native CTAB/current-tab state, independent-reader acceptance, or general multi-layout support.

commit.reason: The test source and plan contain broad pre-existing uncommitted changes. Whole-file staging would include unrelated user work; no broad staging was performed.

assessment.nextLocalAction: Add generated atomic-refusal controls for duplicate/missing layout-dictionary graph edges, then directly inspect the AC1015 VIEWPORT frame boundary.
